magnifyZoomLens.description: actionLists a-122/a-123 (hover in/out) + a-124 (continuous MOUSE_X/MOUSE_Y) — the product page's signature interaction. On hover, a hidden `.zoom-modal` fades in (opacity 0→1, scale 0.25→1, 200ms) revealing a 3x-scaled copy of the product photo. As the cursor moves across the image (0-100% of its bounds), the zoomed copy translates from +200%/-200% (inverse-mapped to cursor position) so it pans opposite the cursor — the classic e-commerce 'magnifying glass' effect. On mouse-out, reverses and hides.

gsap.technique: gsap.quickTo(zoomedImg, 'xPercent'/'yPercent', {duration:0.3, ease:'power2.out'}) called on every mousemove — quickTo reuses one tween instead of creating a new one per event, which is the correct GSAP pattern for high-frequency input like mousemove.

magnifyZoomLens.implementation: src/features/product/ui/product-zoom-image.tsx — gated behind `(hover: hover) and (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)` so touch devices and reduced-motion users get the plain product photo with no dead hover affordance.
